name: dcmnorm
description: Read, inspect, edit, anonymize, validate, transcode and render DICOM medical images with the dcmnorm CLI, and query, send and receive them over a DICOM network (PACS, C-ECHO/C-STORE/C-FIND/C-MOVE) with dcmtalk. Installs the native CLIs from PyPI on first use; files are processed locally, and network operations go only to the DICOM nodes you name.
